text.jp:
なに？
私と共に戦いたい、と？
text.official_en:
What? Are you interested in me fighting as part
of your group?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
まさか、君までも見抜いたというのか？
……ああいや、こちらの話だ。
text.official_en:
Could it be...that you know who I am? Ah, never
mind me. Just a passing thought.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
見てのとおりのしがない旅人なのだがね。
それでも構わないか？
text.official_en:
I'm merely a traveler passing through the area.
Still, you'd like me to join you?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……ふっ。君のような若者から
そこまで乞われたならば、仕方あるまい。
text.official_en:
Well, I never mind providing assistance to those
younger than I when asked for help.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
君と共に往くとしよう。
以後、よろしく頼む。
text.official_en:
I agree and gladly so. Let's work together from
now on.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
そうか。
では、私は旅を続けるとしよう。
text.official_en: I see. Then my travels continue.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス

text.jp:
ほう、私を勧誘しようというのか？
おどろいたが……悪い気はしないな。
text.official_en:
Hmm, you're eager to recruit me? I didn't see this
coming, but I'm not opposed to the idea.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
だが、余計なことに拘っている暇はなくてね。
もっと君に合った仲間を探すと良いだろう。
text.official_en:
I don't have time for it presently. You'd be better off
finding someone more suited for it right now.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
きみのクランに入って欲しいだと？
それはなかなか難しい相談だな。
text.official_en:
You're asking me to join your clan? I would oblige,
but it's not quite that easy.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
私はオルヘルに力を貸しているし
色々とこの地でやりたいことがある。
text.official_en:
I'm supporting Orchel currently, and I also have
some business across this land.
text.real_en:
I'm supporting Orhel currently, and I also have
some business across this land.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ふむ……そこを曲げて頼むというのか？
ずいぶん私を買ってくれているようだな。
text.official_en:
Hmm... But I sense you'd like me to reconsider.
You must think highly of me.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
では、こうしよう。ひとつ、重要な
頼まれ事をきいてくれないだろうか？
text.official_en:
Well then, perhaps you can do me a favor. It's rather
important. So please, hear me out.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
これは、オルヘルたちにも話していないことだ。
くれぐれも内密に頼みたい。
text.official_en:
Now, this must stay between us. I haven't even told
Orchel and the others about it.
text.real_en:
Now, this must stay between us. I haven't even told
Orhel and the others about it.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
私は鍛冶の心得があってね。以前立ち寄った村で、
滞在の礼に、村人に自警の武器を拵えたのだ。
text.official_en:
I have skill in smithing, and not long ago, I forged
weapons for some defenseless villagers.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
必要十分な作りだったが、村人は喜んでくれた。
だがその後、その村が盗賊に襲撃されて……
text.official_en:
The weapons were simple but sufficient. Still, later,
thieves ravaged that poor village.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
今では私の武器は、その盗賊の頭が持ち
悪事に使っているらしく、気にかかっている。
text.official_en:
Their leader now carries one of those weapons and
uses it during their wicked travels. Quite vexing.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
可能なら、そいつらを誅伐し、私の武器を
彼らとともに葬ってくれないだろうか？
text.official_en:
I'd like you to bring justice to those thieves—and
bury my weapon where you find those rogues.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
居場所は突き止めている。助力してくれるなら、
君の話は、考えさせてもらうと約束しよう。
text.official_en:
I know of their whereabouts. I'll consider your
request if you can help me with this matter.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
おお……例の盗賊を倒してくれたのか！
ありがとう。村人たちの供養にもなったろう。
text.official_en:
Ah, so you defeated the thieves? Thank you. I'm
sure it brought peace to the villagers' souls.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
良い者たちだったが、残念なことだ。
私は、ずっと後悔していたのだ。
text.official_en:
They were good people. It's truly a shame. I have
so much regret about all of this.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
もしあの時、もっと強い武器を渡しておけば
彼らは死なずに済んだろうか？
text.official_en:
If I had only given the villagers stronger weapons,
could they have survived?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
いや、結局は、それすらも盗賊の手に渡り
より多くの人間が死んだだろうか？　……とね。
text.official_en:
Or would the thieves have wound up getting stronger
weapons, leading to worse violence?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……おっと、つまらないことを言ったな。
なにやら君は気を許せる相手のようだ。
text.official_en:
Ah, forgive me. I didn't mean to trouble your mind
with such thoughts. I must feel at ease with you.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
オルヘルには悪いが、君たちにも手を貸そう。
これからは、私のことを頼りにするがいい。
text.official_en:
I don't want to neglect Orchel, but I will lend you
my support as well. So, you can count on me.
text.real_en:
I don't want to neglect Orhel, but I will lend you
